mood: Hardware Ops, Cyberpunk, Computational, High-End Terminal

rules: NO Inter, Roboto, or generic sans-serif fonts.
Headings must use Unbounded with tight tracking (tracking-tight).
Body and data (hashes, keys, signatures) must use JetBrains Mono for absolute precision.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny, with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Limit heading sizes; maximum is text-4xl on mobile.
Never use pure black (#000000). Always use the tinted #05050A background.
Primary color (Cyan) is for pure entropy/action triggers only.
Success color (Green) is for passed health tests only.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Control Room Grid (Dense, structural, pure utility, Mobile-first)
rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6).
No generic soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders for definition.

components.cards: Glass-tech ops: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10. Flat, no drop shadows.
components.buttons: Flat background with 1px border. Hover state MUST explicitly change text color and lighten border (e.g., hover:border-cyan-500 hover:text-cyan-400 hover:bg-white/10).
components.bottom_nav: Fixed at bottom. backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/80, with a 1px top border border-white/10.
components.ledger_chain: Vertical timeline layout. Blocks connected by a 1px vertical line (border-l border-white/20). Hash data overflows should truncate with ellipsis.
components.camera_harvest: Overlay the camera feed with a 'Tracing Beam' style scanner bracket. Use a semi-transparent dark overlay to ensure entropy data overlay is readable.

motion.microinteractions: Controlled glow and status-led transitions. Use Framer Motion for subtle entry fades.
motion.hover: Increase border opacity, explicitly define text color changes.

image_urls.description: Abstract glowing nodes for the Digital Universe simulation background to provide depth behind the chart.
3D geometric structure representing the crypto hardware ledger/device signature. Use as a header banner in the Device Identity tab.

iconography: Phosphor Icons for a technical, crisp look. Command for main agent: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first responsive React PWA.
Implement bottom tab bar for navigation (Camera/Harvest, Ledger, Universe, Device).
For the Universe Simulation, use a transparent background chart overlaying the universe_simulation_background image.
Use JetBrains Mono heavily for all hashes, signatures, and entropy bits. Truncate long strings where necessary.
All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='harvest-button'`, `data-testid='ledger-block-0'`).
Ensure hover states use explicit text colors to maintain contrast.
Use standard React / JS ecosystem (no TypeScript).
Avoid Shadcn Cards if they feel too standard; use raw div/section with the defined border/glassmorphism utility classes to achieve the Control Room aesthetic.
